'''SoapBox Search''' is the single search engine for the whole [[SoapBox]] ecosystem. One query looks across every live SoapBox surface '''and''' the [[MELEK]] blockchain itself — posts, wikis, verticals, and on-chain content — so you don't have to know which app holds a thing to find it.

== What it searches ==
SoapBox Search indexes the ecosystem's public surfaces and the MELEK chain together. From one box you can reach:
* On-chain [[MELEK]] posts, accounts, and content.
* This reference, [[The Library of Ashurbanipal]] wiki.
* The [https://witness.melek.salon Witness School], the [https://pool.soapbox.community Pool], and [https://credentials.soapbox.community Credentials].
* The civic verticals ([[SoapBox Law]], Politics, Oversight) and the everyday utility surfaces.
As new verticals go live, Search is the place that finds every one that is up.

== How to use it ==
* Type any word or name and search — results are grouped by which surface they come from.
* Search a MELEK username or [[REN]] name to find a person and their posts.
* Use it as the front door: if you're not sure where something lives in the ecosystem, start here.

Try it at [https://search.soapbox.community search.soapbox.community].

== How it fits ==
Every SoapBox app reads the same [[MELEK]] identity, and Search reads across all of them at once. It is the connective tissue of the ecosystem — the map that ties the [[SoapBox]] verticals and the underlying chains into one searchable whole.
